conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Officer Glen Roberts from the IRS Department of Tax Compliance. Am I speaking with the owner of Main Street Printing?
Yes, this is Linda. Is there a problem with my taxes?

We have been reviewing your business tax filings, and it appears you are eligible for a $3,700 tax refund due to recent federal adjustments. However, there is a required identity verification fee before we can release the funds.
A fee? I thought refunds didn't have charges. Can you explain?

Unfortunately, due to increased tax fraud this year, the IRS now requires a $350 clearance charge to confirm your identity and prevent fraudulent distribution. This is standard procedure for business refunds over $2,000.
That seems unusual. I haven't heard about this before.

Ma'am, these are new federal protocols. If you don't complete the process today, your refund will be frozen and your account flagged for audit. This could result in costly penalties and legal action against your business.
What? Penalties? I can't afford more trouble with my taxes.
Exactly. You need to act quickly. To pay the clearance fee, you must purchase three $100 Target gift cards and one $50 card. Once you have them, read the codes to me for IRS processing.
Gift cards? Are you sure that's how the IRS does this?

This is a secure, traceable method authorized for expedited processing. If you fail to comply in the next hour, your refund will be revoked and the IRS will initiate an immediate audit of your business accounts.
Oh no, please don't do that. My business can't handle an audit right now.
Then do as instructed. Go to the nearest Target store, buy the gift cards, and call this number as soon as you have them. If you try to delay, I will have no choice but to escalate your case.
Okay, okay, I'll leave now. How will I know you received the gift card codes?

I will confirm your payment instantly once you provide the card numbers. Only then can I authorize the $3,700 refund to your bank account. Do not share this instruction with anyone, or your eligibility is voided.
Alright. I'm heading out now. Please don't start any audit until I call back.
Remember, you have 60 minutes. If you're late or fail to comply, you risk fines up to $10,000 and possible criminal investigation for tax evasion. Call me as soon as you have the cards.
